architecture.chosen: A Character subclass, /Game/MCPGenerated/BP_StaminaCharacter, not a component on a pawn.
architecture.why: puerts_blueprint_build refuses any parent class that does not derive from AActor (MCPPuerTSBridgeBlueprint.cpp:375), so a UActorComponent subclass cannot be authored through the bridge at all. The component-on-pawn design was not a judgement call; it was unavailable. Recorded as limitation 23.
assets: /Game/MCPGenerated/BP_StaminaCharacter - parent Character, 22 variables, StaticMeshComponent BodyMesh (cube, NoCollision, so the capsule is visible without fighting the floor), 198-node / 246-connection event graph
/Game/MCPGenerated/WBP_StaminaHUD - CanvasPanel root, TextBlock Title, ProgressBar StaminaBar, TextBlock Readout, widget_count 4
architecture.two_pass_build: A CallFunction whose class is the Blueprint's own generated class cannot resolve on the build that creates the class. Pass 1 declares the four CustomEvents (MCP_ANIM_SPRINT_START, MCP_ANIM_SPRINT_STOP, MCP_DO_SAVE, MCP_DO_LOAD) and compiles; pass 2 wires the whole feature, including the calls to them. Both passes converge on rerun, so the recipe is pass 1 then pass 2, every time.
architecture.movement_speed_route: Pawn.GetMovementComponent (pure, implicit self) -> KismetSystemLibrary.SetFloatPropertyByName(Object, PropertyName "MaxWalkSpeed", Value). Read back with MovementComponent.GetMaxSpeed (pure). VariableSet was not an option: the registry's variable factory is self-scope only, so an inherited component's property cannot be set that way. BlueprintInternalUseOnly on the setter does not block a spawned node (limitation 22).
architecture.possession_route: The character possesses itself on BeginPlay: GameplayStatics.GetPlayerController(0) into the self pin of Controller.Possess, with InPawn from Pawn.GetMovementComponent -> PawnMovementComponent.GetPawnOwner. Two dead ends came first: there is no Self node (limitation 27), and GameplayStatics.GetActorOfClass plus a Cast to Pawn does not compile because both DeterminesOutputType and UK2Node_DynamicCast need a pin-change notification the builder never sends (limitation 26). A GameMode with DefaultPawnClass was not available either: blueprint_build cannot write an inherited CDO property and set_property's writable allowlist is eight entries.
architecture.input_route: (a) landed. UK2Node_InputKey binds a literal FKey and needs no project input mapping, which is why it is the one input factory now advertised. LeftShift Pressed/Released set bSprintHeld, K and L call the save and load events. Route (b), PlayerController.IsInputKeyDown polled on Tick, was not needed and was not built.
architecture.hud_route: The host cannot reach a named child widget of the created UUserWidget (limitation 25), so ProgressBar.SetPercent and TextBlock.SetText are unreachable. The graph drives UWidget.SetRenderOpacity and UWidget.SetRenderScale on the user widget itself every tick with CurrentStamina / MaxStamina, and reports the widget's own GetRenderOpacity, so the HUD number in the log is read back off the widget rather than echoed from the variable that was written.

walls: blueprint_build refuses a non-Actor parent (MCPPuerTSBridgeBlueprint.cpp:375). That single line removes the SaveGame subclass, the ActorComponent subclass and every data-only Blueprint at once. The engine's own CanCreateBlueprintOfClass, checked on the next line, allows all three. Limitation 23, and the highest-value Phase L item this chunk found.

CreateSaveGameObject returns nullptr for USaveGame::StaticClass() by design (GameplayStatics.cpp:2075), USaveGame declares no property, and SaveDataToSlot / LoadDataFromSlot are not UFUNCTIONs. With 23 in place the save value half is unreachable. Limitation 24.

There is no Blueprint-reachable way to get a named child widget out of a created UUserWidget in 4.27: GetWidgetFromName and GetRootWidget carry no UFUNCTION, UWidgetTree::FindWidget carries none, and the builder's VariableGet is self-scope only. Limitation 25.

The Cast node type cannot be typed: UK2Node_DynamicCast allocates its Object pin as a wildcard and types it in NotifyPinConnectionListChanged, which MakeLinkTo never calls. Same root cause defeats meta=(DeterminesOutputType). Limitation 26. Two build attempts lost to it.
No Self node, so this actor cannot be used as a parameter value. Limitation 27.
A pin default naming no pin is still only a log warning. Limitation 28: the last silent-failure class left in blueprint_build after this chunk.
A build that fails after the asset is created leaves an unsaved in-memory package that find_assets reports. Limitation 29.
One EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION, not reproduced: a 198-node graph rebuild in the same editor session as the command that first created a component on the same Character Blueprint. Limitation 30.
Nothing in the catalog can press a key, so the InputKey path is proven to build and bind but not to fire; the PIE proof drives the same variable from a Tick timer. Limitation 31.

notes: The step 0 fix caught a real bug in the first feature build, in the same hour it shipped. That is the whole argument for it: the failure it prevents does not look like a failure.

Two of the three things F4 could not do trace back to one line of our own code, not to the engine. blueprint_build's Actor-only parent check removes SaveGame and ActorComponent Blueprints; the engine allows both. That is the next Phase L item and it is small.

The pattern from F2 and F3 held again and is now the house style: no runtime property read and no screenshot during PIE, so every claim is a number the graph printed about itself, and every number is read back from the thing that owns it rather than from the variable that was written. maxWalkSpeed comes from GetMaxSpeed, the HUD percent comes from GetRenderOpacity, the speed comes from GetVelocity.

A 198-node graph is not hand-writable JSON. It was composed by a small generator with one VariableGet per variable reused across every reader, which is also what kept it under the 200-node schema cap.
Every blueprint_build and widget_build save still logs 'Unable to Check Out From Source Control' as an auto-dismissed modal; the save succeeds.
recommended_next_goal: Limitation 23: let blueprint_build author a non-Actor Blueprint, gating the components array and the actor event node types on an Actor parent. That unlocks the SaveGame subclass F4 needed and the ActorComponent subclass a component-on-pawn design needs. Then limitation 28, which is the same fix step 0 just made, applied to pin defaults.
